description: Plan a Hyperliquid short that hedges a Solana token position: runs the pre-trade scans pair_data, wallet_balance (if you pass a wallet), token_security and funding_rate_arbitrage, then sizes the short on the token's own perp (or SOL with a beta estimate if it has none) and shows funding, liquidation price and distance, margin and fees. Read-only: places no order. One fixed charge covers the scans at list price ($0.005 + $0.001 + $0.001 + $0.01; the wallet scan's share is included even when you pass an amount) plus $0.003 for the plan. If a scan fails or no viable plan can be made you get an error and pay nothing. Hyperliquid excludes US persons. Costs $0.02 USDC per call.

amount.description: Token units held (pass this or walletAddress)

hedgeRatio.description: Share of the position to hedge, 0.01–1 (default 1)

leverage.description: Leverage for the short, whole number (default 2; capped at the perp's maximum)

mintAddress.description: Solana token mint to hedge, or 'SOL'

walletAddress.description: Solana wallet to read the balance from (pass this or amount)

name: hedge_plan
title: Hedge plan
